nodes.label: Five AKM Question Types Pattern
nodes.rationale: Single-file HTML+CSS+Vanilla JS template combining one shared stimulus with 5 AKM question types (PG, PGK Benar/Salah, Menjodohkan, Isian Singkat, Uraian) without external libraries so it runs directly in any browser or can be pasted into the HAXcms HTML Source View editor; answer key hardcoded in frontend for a no-database scenario.

nodes.label: HAXcms HTML Source View Integration
nodes.rationale: To embed in HAXcms without wrapping as a full Web Component, copy the stimulus-to-form/script block into the HTML/Source Code View editor; suggested future enhancements are countdown timer and green/red per-question visual feedback.

nodes.label: Data Flow Table to Google Sheets
nodes.rationale: Maps each student action to its Google Sheets target and event: login -> Users (quiz-user-login), submit tugas -> Tugas Log (assignment-saved, activity type assignment), post/reply forum -> Forum Log (discussion-saved, discussion), submit quiz -> [Pertemuan]-Kuis (quiz-saved, quiz), read materi -> [Pertemuan]-Aktivitas (reading-saved, reading), generate rapor -> Akumulasi Nilai Rapor.
nodes.norm_label: data flow table to google sheets

nodes.label: Google Sheets schemas (Forum Log / Tugas Log / Akumulasi)
nodes.rationale: New code.gs sheets: Forum Log [Timestamp, CommentID, ParentID, UserName, StudentID, Text, Sheet, Action, Likes]; Tugas Log [Timestamp, StudentID, Nama, Sheet, Title, Content]; Akumulasi appends [Skor Sikap, Skor Keterampilan, Nilai Akhir, Grade] to existing columns.

nodes.label: hide-answers quiz property
nodes.rationale: Boolean (default false) that hides correct/wrong feedback and button highlight so the quiz can be used as a closed exam.

nodes.label: hide-confetti quiz property
nodes.rationale: Boolean (default false) disabling the confetti effect on correct answers for exam mode.

nodes.label: DDD Theme CSS Fallback Pattern
nodes.rationale: All DDD CSS variables carry hardcoded fallbacks (e.g. var(--ddd-theme-success, #28a745)) so answer buttons remain visible even when the host page never initializes DDD theme variables.

nodes.label: Google Drive/Doc Link in Assignment
nodes.rationale: assignment-forum gains an input type=url field and _assignmentLink state that is sent to Sheets; code.gs and code-forum-tugas.gs add a 'Link' column to Tugas Log so students can attach Google Drive/Doc files.

nodes.label: AKM JSON Question Formats and Scoring
nodes.rationale: Documents explode-quiz JSON question schema: PG uses correctIndex (1 poin); PG multi-correct uses correctAnswers array (1 poin only if ALL selected correct); pgk uses statements[{text,answer}] (all rows correct); matching uses leftItems/rightItems/correctPairs; shortAnswer uses acceptedAnswers with case-insensitive includes match. Feature: image URL per question and shuffle-choices.
nodes.norm_label: akm json question formats and scoring

nodes.label: Attendance Threshold Logic
nodes.rationale: A student counts as present in a week if they do at least 1 assignment AND 1 forum post; thresholds configured in attendance-system.js: minWeeklyActivities 10, minAssignment 1, minDiscussion 1, minReading 5, minQuiz 1. assignment-saved and discussion-saved events are recorded to Google Sheets via activity-logger.

nodes.label: Grade Weighting by quiz-category
nodes.rationale: quiz-category determines grade weighting: uts and uas each enter final grade calculation with weight 2/8, ulangan_harian with 3/8; lecturer mode (6 weight components Kehadiran:UH:UTS:UAS:Sikap:Skill) lets lecturers input UTS/UAS manually, auto-calc sikap from tugas+forum and skill from quiz+baca.

nodes.label: Per-Choice Image URL Format
nodes.rationale: Backward-compatible choice format: plain string = text only, object {text, image} adds a per-choice image URL; helpers _getChoiceText(choice) and _getChoiceImage(choice) normalize both forms.

nodes.label: Matching Partial Score
nodes.rationale: _submitMatching() scores per pair: earned = round(correctCount/left.length * points); confetti fires only when ALL pairs are correct. Example: 4 pairs with points 4, 2 correct -> earned 2 points.

nodes.label: show-after-quiz Gradebook Timing
nodes.rationale: Transparent gradebook shows scores only after quiz completion: root cause was a missing quiz-saved listener in connectedCallback leaving _quizCompleted false; fixed by registering window 'quiz-saved' listener and always rendering the gradebook (gradebook-hidden property removed).

nodes.label: viewMode student/lecturer
nodes.rationale: viewMode student = read-only self grade transparency; lecturer = adds Mode Dosen button for weight config, rapor generation, manual UTS/UAS entry. Warning: writing view-mode twice on one element lets the second attribute override the first.

nodes.label: Grade Card Weights â€” Nilai Akhir = Kehadiran 12.5% + UH 37.5% + UTS 25% + UAS 25%
nodes.rationale: UTS/UAS dihitung 0 bila belum diisi; pengelompokan UH/UTS/UAS dalam laporan bergantung pada konsistensi teks Kode Materi/Kategori Kuis; Kehadiran = rata-rata aktivitas per pertemuan, dihitung ulang otomatis.
nodes.norm_label: grade card weights a€” nilai akhir = kehadiran 12.5% + uh 37.5% + uts 25% + uas 25%

nodes.label: Single pertemuan-kuis Sheet â€” all quiz results in one sheet keyed by Kode Materi (tag)
nodes.rationale: Semua hasil kuis dari semua pertemuan/ulangan/UTS/UAS disimpan ke satu sheet 'pertemuan-kuis'; sheet lama 'X - Kuis' tetap dibaca untuk kompatibilitas, penulisan baru hanya ke sheet tunggal; upsert nilai terbaik per siswa+Kode Materi agar kuis ulang tidak merusak nilai terbaik.
nodes.norm_label: single pertemuan-kuis sheet a€” all quiz results in one sheet keyed by kode materi (tag)

nodes.label: DDD CSS Token Fallback â€” var(--ddd-*, hardcoded) pattern in .question-text
nodes.rationale: Pakai DDD design tokens dulu, lalu fallback hardcoded bila token belum tersedia agar styling tetap berjalan tanpa design system.

nodes.label: Dynamic Weight Auto-calc â€” totalWeight recomputed from weights (client & server)
